title: AI-Driven SaaS Platform Integration: AI Express for Unified Generative AI Services with Pay-As-You-Go Credit Systems and Scalable Microservice Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2611.05389v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI is currently fragmented, with separate subscriptions required for text generation, image synthesis, and code assistance, leading to high costs and workflow disruptions. AI Express is a SaaS platform that consolidates these capabilities into a unified pay-as-you-go service. The platform provides a range of AI tools, including a Core Code Reviewer that evaluates GitHub repositories, a Text-to-Website generator that converts text into fully functional websites, script generation, grammar checking, data analysis, and watermark removal, all accessible through a single interface without requiring technical expertise.

translated_title: AI驱动的SaaS平台集成：AI Express统一生成式AI服务——基于按量付费积分系统与可扩展微服务架构
translated_abstract: 当前的生成式AI服务呈现碎片化状态，文本生成、图像合成和代码辅助等功能需要分别订阅，导致成本高昂且工作流程频繁中断。AI Express是一个SaaS平台，将这些能力整合为统一的按量付费服务。该平台提供一系列AI工具，包括用于评估GitHub代码仓库的核心代码审查器、可将文本转换为完整功能网站的文本转网站生成器，以及脚本生成、语法检查、数据分析和水印去除等功能，所有工具均可通过单一界面访问，无需任何专业技术知识。
tldr: AI Express通过按量付费积分系统和可扩展微服务架构，将碎片化的生成式AI能力（代码审查、文本转网站、语法检查等）整合到单一SaaS平台中，使用户无需多重订阅和技术专长即可低成本使用统一的AI服务。
en_tdlr: AI Express unifies fragmented generative AI capabilities—including code review, text-to-website generation, and grammar checking—into a single SaaS platform with a pay-as-you-go credit system and scalable microservice architecture, eliminating multiple subscriptions and the need for technical expertise.
